purpose: Writing coverage and evidence gates; not a task, acceptance receipt or final freeze

evidence_states.locked_definition: Authoritative problem or accounting convention; does not assert investment performance
evidence_states.accepted_implementation: Reviewed computational behavior; does not accept future run results
evidence_states.submitted_pending_review: Exact worker result exists but cannot support manuscript outcome claims yet
evidence_states.design_pending_review: Chief proposal exists; independent design review is incomplete
evidence_states.not_available: Required result or final artifact does not exist yet
evidence_states.prototype_pending_review: Chief-authored source and synthetic checks exist; independent code approval and production results are absent
evidence_states.accepted_development_evidence: Exact reviewed development artifacts accepted; not final or policy-selection evidence
evidence_states.accepted_negative_review: Independent evidence accepted; reviewed design/code requires stated corrections and is not approved
evidence_states.accepted_design: Independent design approval only; neither code nor future outcomes are certified.
evidence_states.failed_implementation_attempt: Exact failed receipt preserved; code not accepted even when narrower numerical checks pass.
evidence_states.report_transform_pending_review: Chief-prepared transformation of accepted data; source outcomes accepted, independent figure/wording review still pending.
evidence_states.accepted_format_restriction: Exact reviewed PDF/PNG-only publication restriction; preserves SVG defect, original failed validation and separate full-paper review.
evidence_states.authorized_pending_result_acceptance: Immutable fixed task published; no numerical outcome accepted and no manuscript performance claim permitted.
